alensarangsatheesh-indian-stocks-fundame.description: Produce a rigorous, sector-relative, multi-factor fundamental analysis of a publicly listed company — Indian (NSE/BSE) or US/global. Use this skill whenever the user asks to analyse, research, evaluate, value, or "look into" a stock, ticker, or listed company; asks whether a business is fundamentally strong or weak, cheap or expensive; asks to compare two or more companies or benchmark one against its sector; mentions metrics like OPM, ROCE, ROE, ROIC, P/E, EV/EBITDA, free cash flow, NIM, GNPA, CASA, promoter holding or pledging; or shares an annual report, 10-K, concall transcript, or…
